operating_notes.text: MTNL failed to fund escrow account for 7.80% Bond Series VIII-C interest due on May 7, 2026, relying on GoI sovereign guarantee.
MTNL funded the escrow for the 7th semi-annual interest on 8.00% Bond Series VII A due 15 May 2026; the filing does not state the amount.
MTNL reported total financial indebtedness of ₹36,545 Cr, including defaulted bank borrowings of ₹9,340 Cr.
Imposed fines of ₹5.31 lakh each by BSE and NSE for board composition non-compliance under Regulation 17(1).
Funded Bank of India escrow account for 7th semi-annual interest on 7.87% MTNL Bond Series VII B due June 1, 2026.
TRAI imposed financial disincentive of ₹4,00,000 for wireline service quality for June 2026 quarter and ₹3,00,000 for wireless service quality for April 2026.

timeline.summary: MTNL failed to fund the interest escrow account for Bond Series VIII-C due to insufficient funds, triggering sovereign guarantee provisions.
2026-05-12: MTNL funded the Bank of India escrow account for the 7th semi-annual interest on 8.00% Bond Series VII A, due 15 May 2026.
On 18 May 2026, MTNL reported defaults of ₹9,340 Cr in bank loan principal and interest, with total indebtedness at ₹36,545 Cr as of April 30, 2026.
On May 28, 2026, MTNL disclosed Crisil Ratings' rationale maintaining its ₹6,500 Cr bonds and ₹20 Cr NCDs on 'Watch Negative'.
MTNL received ₹5.31 lakh fines each from BSE and NSE for non-compliance with board composition rules.
On May 29, 2026, MTNL announced the funding of its Bank of India escrow account for the 7th semi-annual interest on Bond Series VII B due June 1, 2026.
MTNL received two TRAI orders on 13 October 2026 for financial disincentives totaling ₹7.00 lakh for quality of service contraventions.
